notes.title: Game Update: New Game Mode and Playable Character
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

 We just updated the game with a new game mode that features a completely new playable character: THE BADMAN.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33831007/4073c98211a342c1d918ad7f59c204e973e8e2f9.jpg

 This mode is intended to have a more classic shmup feel, THE BADMAN is a glass cannon character. His BADSHIP packs more of a punch but he dies in one hit. 

 Which means that this new mode is also lives based, unlike the normal health bar based game mode, and score is more important too since every certain amount of score you gain a new life.

 3 new achievements have also been added which are unlocked playing THE BADMAN mode!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33831007/ec8731b517d093778fa370c50c676f58f29ee671.gif

Check it out and let us know what you think!

The game is also 20% off because of the Steam Winter Sale, an even better opportunity to give it a try!

notes.title: Game Update: SUPER Power-ups!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33831007/db1082bec0a5105f541e57d68b2985ca41cbccf1.gif

We just updated the game with some fixes, adjustments and additions to gameplay!


 First of all, POWERUPS! Enemies now have a chance of dropping them when dying. There are 4 Power-ups: Spread Shot, Pierce Shot, Explosive Shot and Orb Shield!

 Added more information on the HUD of how to use Super Powers.

 Fire rate and XP gained when LVL1 AND LVL2 increased.

 Normal laser attack travels faster.

 Stun time when getting hit was reduced by half.

notes.title: Pre-release small patch
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

In preparation for the game coming out soon and thanks to useful feedback, some adjustments and changes have been made. We are looking forward for you to play the best possible version of our game. There's more things we would like to add or change but we want to wait and see how the release goes.

A quick rundown:


 Reduced the playable character's size by 15%.

 Default player speed increased 5%.

 Fire rate when Player is Level 1 and Level 2 was increased.

 Amount of experience needed to level up was reduced.

 The way Superpowers can be upgraded was reworked a little bit. Each skill now has 4 upgrades instead of 2, but the number of times you can level up your character and the amount of skillpoints you get will be the same. This means at Max Level not every skill can upgraded fully, allowing for more choice and commitment when it comes to playstyle.
